regions.merged_text: Here's an envelope which I thing I must have addressed to you early in August, wanting to thank you for your kind favor received some- time befor that; so because I neglected to do that even last Monday when you were here, I'll at least acknowledge same favor. Fr. Gabriel came down Thursday and is conducting the 40 hours Devotion in S S. Peter and Paul Church - our Parish. Everything seems quiet and satisfactory. Deo Gratias. Pray for the multiplication of vocations and for the conversions of poor sinners. God help us. . .. That we be appreciative and make at least some progress towards real gratitude.
